6100101.ContentEN:
Where campfire light meets water, daffodils bloom.
A woman studies her rippling reflection — captivating enough to make the night sky pause in wonder.

6100102.ContentEN:
"My beloved, where do you wander?"
"I've searched all Atlasia — through Luca's azure isles and Huaxu's emerald vales, where Aethyrie's breezes linger in the treetops, and where the Askard Fjord spring cracks the thinning ice."

6100103.ContentEN:
[[
"Yet I've found no one to cherish."
"The beauty who equals me must be imprisoned in the Sacred Lake of Elysium."
She murmurs softly to her own reflection.]]

6100105.1:
studying you with a fleeting glance.
"Come back when you've learned how to set her free."]]
6100105.ContentEN:
[[
"Who are you? A passing traveler?"
She lifts her gaze

6100106.ContentEN: Try to pick a daffodil from the lake

6100201.1:
a lone old man tirelessly swings his hammer beside a mountain of discarded weapons.
One blow brings utter stillness
6100201.2:
the next ignites dancing firelights across the forge.
You approach
6100201.3: but the old man keeps his eyes fixed on his work.]]

6100202.ContentEN:
[[
"Another fool comes to die."
"Tell me, what year is it now?"]]

6100204.ContentEN:
You open your mouth to answe r— but wait.
What year is it now? What year should it be?
In the endless dark, you lost all measure of time long ago.

6100207.ContentEN:
"So you're no different," he sighs.
"I stopped counting how many years I've been trapped here. The memories are gone — all that's left is this hammer, and the wrinkles time carved into me."

6100208.ContentEN: "While the fire still burns… speak. What is it you want?"

6100209.ContentEN: Choose a weapon from the pile.

6100210.ContentEN: Ask him to forge a weapon for you.

6100301.ContentEN:
A song rises beside the lonely campfire.
A woman approaches—her steps light as feathers, her voice clear as a nightingale's call.

6100302.ContentEN:
A leaden drowsiness creeps over you.
The darkness before your eyes crumples like parchment, dissolving in water.
……

6100303.1:
while sunlight spills through the dense canopy in golden shafts.
Snow-white flying squirrels gently sip dawn dew. Azure lynxes and pale hares do not startle at your footsteps
6100303.2: they simply go about their business.]]
6100303.ContentEN:
[[
You wander through sunlit woods and streams.
Water murmurs across velvet grass

6100305.ContentEN:
You sit in a tavern at dusk.
A bard plays his accordion as returning sailors clap and raise their voices in harmony.
Amid salty sea winds and sweet malt ale, you step into the heart of the crowd and dance—your feet light, your heart lighter.

6100307.ContentEN:
You kneel beneath the sacred hall's stained glass.
The white-robed goddess gazes down from her towering portrait — serene, silent, and sorrowful.
The lunar deity steps forth from the mosaic's kaleidoscope hues, her beaded crown brushing your cheek as she kisses your forehead……

6100308.ContentEN:
[[
THWACK!
A sharp flick to your forehead snaps you out of sleep.]]

6100309.ContentEN: "I am the best Dreamweaver in Elysium! I work my fingers to the bone crafting perfect dreams, and you just lie there snoring? At least throw me a coin!"

6100310.1: flicking your forehead again in frustration.]]

6100401.ContentEN: An old man approaches the campfire. You notice he's carrying a lantern.

6100402.ContentEN:
"Let me see… Oh! So you have a lantern too!"
"Yet all flames must fade in time. You know this — without light in the abyss, darkness claims you forever."

6100403.ContentEN: "Best carry a spare lantern. Even the faintest glow may save your life on the road ahead."

6100405.ContentEN:
"Ah… Such generosity, traveler! May the God of Stars smile upon you on your path."
Every wrinkle on his face dances with delight.

6100406.ContentEN: Ask if he has other useful items

6100407.ContentEN:
"Ah… Such generosity, traveler! May the God of Stars smile upon you on your path."
Every wrinkle on his face dances with delight.

6100409.ContentEN:
"Oh… My gracious. May the God of Abundance bless you, lest you remain this desperate — risking life over mere coins."
He grumbles away.

6100501.ContentEN: "Wayward soul, the gods shall light your way."

6100502.ContentEN:
A chorus of children's voices blooms in your mind. The campfire's glow dissolves into radiant light as your body grows weightless.
You float amidst a thousand whispering winds—cotton clouds brushing your fingertips, while golden towers pierce the clouds, their radiant silhouettes humming with silent invitation.

6100503.ContentEN: "Come. Receive the gods' grace and ascend beyond the clouds. The mortal realm fades beneath you; perfect bliss awaits."

6100505.ContentEN:
[[
You understand that every blessing from the heavens comes with a price.
You trust the path you tread with your own steps to empty promises of paradise.]]

6100507.ContentEN:
The clouds cradle you gently like a mother's embrace.
Golden gates swing wide—just long enough to glimpse gods' shadows moving beyond. Then the clouds dissipate, depositing you back onto familiar soil.

6100509.ContentEN:
You stretch toward the sky into that cottony illusion—pain licks up from your fingers like wildfire.
Light vanishes. Wind screams past as you plummet.

6100510.ContentEN: Of course. The abyss has no sky.

6100601.ContentEN:
The figure draws near—
a girl, barely taller than a child with a fragile frame.

6100602.ContentEN:
"May I… just… warm myself… by your fire?"
Her voice trembles. Water droplets roll from her soaked dress.

6100603.ContentEN: "I can't find my mom… It's freezing here… Please, let me sit by your fire! Just for a few minutes… I'll be…"

6100605.ContentEN:
[[
"Th-thank you."
Her voice trembles as the words slip through chattering teeth.]]

6100607.ContentEN:
"Why… why am I… That's right…"
"Dad… Mom… They're… Hyperboreans… We fled… trying to reach… Elysium…"
"At the sea… Our ship… swallowed by… a swirling black hole…"

6100608.ContentEN: The swirling black hole — you know it by its name. It's the black tide, the ravenous abyss that devours all substance.

6100609.ContentEN: Ask why her family risked going to Elysium

6100610.ContentEN:
"Mon said… we were Demon's Children…"
"Even falling into the abyss… would be better… than staying in Hyperborea…"

6100611.ContentEN: "Thank you for the fire… and for letting me know… I'm already gone."

6100612.ContentEN: She vanishes. Nothing is left but the flickering campfire, like she was never here at all.

6100614.ContentEN: "I'm… I'm sorry… I didn't mean to bother you."

6100615.ContentEN: Shaking, the girl disappears from view. Nothing is left but the flickering campfire, like she was never here at all.

6100702.ContentEN: A cheerful young man with a backpack walks up to the campfire and greets you loudly.

6100703.ContentEN: "Don't mean to be blunt — but you're alive, right?"

6100705.ContentEN: "Never thought I'd meet another living soul out here! Guess we're both the lucky ones, huh?"

6100706.ContentEN:
"Dad and I wrote a little folk song when I was 16. Apparently, the Hall of Divine Judgment didn't appreciate our lyrics."
"I should've been executed like my poor dad — until lightning struck the executioner on the very day."

6100707.ContentEN:
"At 20, I joined a band of traveling merchants. We were ambushed in a forest up in the North — tied up and abandoned in a cavern."
"I watched my companions starve to death one by one until dawn on the seventh day when a snuffling boar rooted me awake. A girl gave me some food. Pretty sure I was looking at an angel."

6100708.ContentEN:
[[
"Later I traveled with a group of Knights into the abyss as a merchant. Their lights died one after another. An elder Knight tripped and found his sword buried in his own neck. I was the only one who survived."
"That was when I knew the Goddess of Fate had my back. That she would bless me with boundless luck and happiness."]]

6100709.ContentEN:
[[
"If she led me here, there must be something truly one-of-a-kind waiting in the depths. I won't keep it waiting."
He puts on his heavy backpack.]]

6100710.1:
pumping his fists.
"To our good fortune!"]]
6100710.ContentEN:
[[
"Listen, my friend! If she spared you as well, then destiny has something wonderful in store just for you!"
He laughs

6100712.ContentEN:
"Are you passed out?"
He crouches down, testing for breath.
"Don't tell me you're… one of the souls too?"

6100713.ContentEN:
[[
You remain silent.
He sets down his backpack and pulls out water and food.]]

6100714.ContentEN: "Here, for you, my poor friend! May the first light over the sacred tower find you awake and well again."

6100801.ContentEN:
Two blood-red flowers, entwined at the stem, pulse with an eerie radiance.
You raise your lantern — its light spills over strands of faded blonde hair and segments of pallid vertebrae. Is this a Filthoid wearing human skin… or a man on the verge of becoming one?
You tense, grip tightening around your weapon — yet it makes no move to strike. Only those crimson eyes, set deep in shadow, watch you in silence.

6100802.ContentEN: Suddenly, its throat emits a fractured sound — like jagged stones grinding together, yet pulsing with strange rhythm. Against all reason, you comprehend the meaning—

6100803.ContentEN: "Please stay a moment, traveler with the lantern. Pray tell, do I still look beautiful in your light?"

6100804.ContentEN:
[[
"I braided my hair soft and shining, weaving beauty into every strand." Its fingers traced the ruptured flesh at the back of its head.
"I pressed my gown to perfection, adorned it with jewels fit for a queen." Its fingers brushed where crystal spikes tore through the flesh.
"I wear the necklace my lover gave me, to honor his devotion." Its fingers lingered over the jagged bones rising from its throat."]],

6100806.ContentEN: Those crimson eyes quiver ever so slightly, like petals trembling in the wind.

6100807.ContentEN:
[[
"Thank you, kind traveler. Please accept a token of my gratitude."
"If you cross paths with my love, please tell him I'll always love him."]]

6100809.ContentEN: The crimson eyes are covered by savage claws.

6100810.ContentEN:
[[
"No! My beloved must not see me in this wretched form."
"Please put me out of my misery, merciful traveler."]]

6100902.ContentEN: A finely-dressed young man pauses in the flickering firelight, offering you a graceful bow.

6100903.ContentEN: "I'm seeking a lady with crimson eyes. Have you glimpsed her passing?"

6100904.ContentEN:
"She sings with such grace, even the nightingale falls silent in envy."
"Her golden hair flows like liquid sunlight, brighter than spring marigolds in bloom."
"She wears a gown of regal elegance, embroidered with jewels that shimmer like the night sky."
"And around her neck rests my gift — a crimson pendant, deep and mysterious as her gaze."

6100905.ContentEN: You haven't seen a lady like that.

6100906.ContentEN:
"I see…"
His gaze falters briefly—just a moment — before composure returns.
"That's fine. My search continues."

6100907.ContentEN: The young man settles by the campfire, flames dancing in his untainted eyes.

6100908.ContentEN:
"We were betrothed — she to be my bride upon her coming of age. Yet the gods marked her: a sacred sigil bloomed upon her brow. On the eve of her fourteenth birthday, their envoys spirited her away."
"Her parting words begged me to move on. But my vow stands eternal — this life belongs to her alone."
"When I find her, I'll bring her back to the world. The God of Full Moon, the patron of lovers, will surely bless our reunion."

6100909.ContentEN: Wish him luck in finding his lover.

6100910.ContentEN:
"My gratitude, kind traveler."
"Please accept this humble gift — may fortune smile upon your own desires."

6100912.ContentEN:
A faint smile touches his lips.
"Then I shall surrender this flesh to the Sacred Lake — that my soul may dwell eternally where hers resides."

6101001.ContentEN: A woman emerges by the campfire. She reaches her left hand into the flames, gathers soot, and scrawls unrecognizable symbols across the ground.

6101002.ContentEN:
"Ah— time-defiant traveler, you who walk with despair, death clings to your shadow like a second skin."
She whispers.

6101004.ContentEN:
[[
"Ah, my dear friend. As you see, I am a poet."
"My quill now births its thousand-and-first child: your very own ode!"]]

6101007.ContentEN:
"My dear, behold—"
She spreads her pale hand before you — no blisters, no scars.
"A wise traveler like yourself must've known this is no true flame, and I am no mortal soul."

6101008.ContentEN: The poet reaches into the fire again, slender fingers weaving through flames like a performer's nimble feet.

6101009.ContentEN:
"What a wondrous place, don't you think?"
"Freed at last from flesh's torment, no mundane distractions to dull my inspiration. I am boundless now… I wield eternity!"
"Traveler, my gratitude for your pause — your presence kindles inspiration's spark. Take these verses, and may they guide you beyond the wheel of fate to your heart's desire."

6101010.ContentEN:
The poet reaches out — embers surge like a tempest, swallowing your vision whole.
When the ash settles, only silence remains.

6101101.ContentEN: "Good day, Sir. May I share your fire's warmth?"

6101110.ContentEN:
"Hey… are you okay? Did you see something scary?"
He tilts his head, eyes wide with innocent confusion.

6101111.ContentEN:
You open your mouth but no words come out.
The black thorns engulf the boy, swallowing him whole — until the boy, the book, and the thorns vanish into the void.

6101113.ContentEN: You are not here to study books.

6101114.ContentEN:
"Oh, okay, I'll read it by myself then…"
He puts the book back onto his lap.

6101115.ContentEN:
Suddenly, writhing black thorns burst from its pages.
Before you can react, the black thorns engulf the boy, swallowing him whole — until the boy, the book, and the thorns vanish into the void.

6101201.ContentEN: A middle-aged woman settles by the campfire, her grim expression untouched by the flickering light.

6101202.ContentEN: "Greetings, stranger. Pardon my asking, what is this place?"

6101204.ContentEN:
"Sacred lake…? Abyss…?" Her voice wavers with confusion. "These words mean nothing to me…"
She stares at her weathered hands. "I can't remember why I'm here."

6101205.ContentEN: Tell her about the history of the Sacred Lake

6101206.ContentEN:
"People bearing sacred sigils… will be brought here…?"
"Ah… I remember now. My child is here. The sacred sigil appeared at the corner of her eye — like a butterfly about to take flight."

6101208.ContentEN:
[[
"Good idea."
She reaches into her pocket

6101209.ContentEN: "Ah… I remember now." She gently buffs the brooch with her sleeve. "This… this is meant for my child."

6101210.ContentEN: She looks up. The firelight now burns clearly in her eyes.

6101211.ContentEN:
"I came for my child."
"They took her while she slept when I was not home. My girl's always feared strangers… If she wakes to unfamiliar faces—"
"I need to be with her… Yes. That's why I'm here."

6101213.ContentEN: "Ten days ago… no, ten months… or is it ten years… Ah… I can't recall."

6101307.ContentEN: The girl keeps tossing the rocks. Maybe it's your imagination, but the flames seem to drift closer, gently caressing her golden hair.

6101308.ContentEN:
[[
"Come morning, the flames will be as they were, and these rocks will scatter around here once more."
"So every day, I gather and toss them into the flames again. Exactly one hundred forty-six of them."]]

6101310.ContentEN: The girl tilts her head, blinking with an innocent smile.

6101311.ContentEN:
"No, I love fire," she says. "I love its crackling sound, its dancing light."
"You see, space twists here. You close your eyes by the campfire and wake up at the bottom of the lake."
"But these little rocks are different — no matter how the world shifts, they always return. Just knowing I'll find them tomorrow lets me sleep in peace."

6101402.ContentEN: Feeble moans rise from the ground. You spot a skeleton of a man collapsing near the firepit, his hollow cheeks speaking of starvation.

6101404.ContentEN:
"…Thank you for the kindness, kid. But my body's past eating."
"The black tide dragged me under. All the bread in the world couldn't save me now."
"You remind me of a little girl in Elysium… A child as kind-hearted as you."

6101405.ContentEN:
"She had golden locks, riding a giant pink boar. When I was starving on the streets, she offered me a piece of bread…"
"But my pride ran too deep. I refused the Elysian Church's charity and spat venom at her kindness."

6101406.ContentEN:
"Now, looking back… I realise she might have been the only one who truly cared."
"Faith, race, birth… People use these things to embellish themselves… But no title can outshine the radiance of genuine kindness…"

6101407.ContentEN: "If I could go back… I'd kneel to beg her forgiveness… I don't think I have the chance now…"

6101408.ContentEN:
His voice fades into whispers. You blink — and he's gone.
The scent of fresh-baked bread lingers in the air.

yet your pack holds barely enough for yourself.

6101410.ContentEN:
[[
Your heart aches at his state

6101501.ContentEN:
A golden light flashes — for a moment, you mistake it for dawn. Then you see it: a radiant bird, gliding down to land gracefully beside you.
Its feathers gleam like firelit gold, finer than any noble's treasure.

6101503.ContentEN: You pour water into your palm and offer it to the bird.

6101504.ContentEN:
It tilts its head, watching warily — then, with regal grace, dips its golden beak to sip.
With a grateful trill, it shakes its radiant feathers and takes flight—a golden spiral into the sky.

6101505.ContentEN: Pluck a feather from its tail

6101506.ContentEN: You reach quietly, plucking a golden tail feather while the bird rests. Its luster rivals the finest gold, priceless beyond measure.

6101507.ContentEN: The bird shrieks in fury, wings flaring as it dives. Its beak strikes like molten gold — searing a crimson brand into the palm of your hand.

6101508.ContentEN: By the time the pain fades, the last glint of gold has long disappeared into the clouds.

6101509.ContentEN: Pluck a feather from its head

6101510.ContentEN:
Your fingers creep toward its head — but the bird snaps alert, eyes flashing open before you can strike.
The bird shrieks in fury, wings flaring as it dives. Its beak strikes like molten gold — searing a crimson brand into the palm of your hand.

6101511.ContentEN: By the time the pain fades, the last glint of gold has long disappeared into the clouds.

6101601.ContentEN:
A putrid stench and reek of decay cut the air near you.
You see a girl emerge by the campfire. Her face and arms fester with weeping sores. Only the fire's reflection in her eyes betrays a flicker of life — without it, she might as well be a corpse.

6101602.ContentEN: You rummage through your backpack and offer the girl medicine.

6101603.ContentEN:
"Thank you… kind traveler…"
Her head lifts slowly. You can't tell if that twisted smile is gratitude or just a grimace of pain.

6101604.ContentEN:
"But please… Don't help me," she murmurs. "The Priest said this curse — this abyssal sickness — is my punishment…"
"I must repent sincerely… Then I'll get better… Until then, I must stay away from everyone."

6101605.ContentEN: The girl staggers to her feet and vanishes into the darkness.

6101607.ContentEN: You cautiously approach the girl, trying to assess her wounds.

6101608.ContentEN:
"Cough…!"
She coughs violently—dark crimson blood spatters your outstretched hand, curling into ominous black mist.

6101609.ContentEN:
"I-I'm sorry…!"
She staggers upright and tries to retreat, but collapses back to the ground.

6101610.ContentEN:
"The Priest said this curse — this abyssal sickness — is my punishment…"
"I must repent sincerely… Then I'll get better… Until then, I must stay away from everyone."

6101611.ContentEN: The girl struggles up once more, then stumbles away into the swallowing dark.

6101613.ContentEN: Every nerve tenses at the sight of her symptoms. You get up and retreat, putting distance between you and the coughing girl.

6101614.ContentEN: "My apologies… for startling you… I-I'll leave right now…"

6101615.ContentEN: The girl staggers to her feet and vanishes into the darkness.
